conditional_clauses.note: Where the intern will handle personal data, the DPDP Act obligations must be stated.

mandatory_legal_checks: PoSH Act 2013 S.2(f) — 'employee' expressly includes an intern; the Act applies of its own force and cannot be contracted out of
Misclassification risk — control, integration and the substance of the work decide the relationship, not the label 'intern'
Apprentices Act 1961 — where the engagement is in truth an apprenticeship, that Act applies instead
Income-tax Act 1961 S.10(16) — whether a stipend is exempt depends on its nature, not its name
